title: Simply Stats
description: as the name suggest the mod is about a simply stats tracker on the top left of your screen
body:
# Simply Stats
This is a mod tracking stats on top left of your screen
What is added so far:
1. Distance Traveled Stat
2. Mining Stat
3. Slaying Stat

The mod was created with MCreator: [https://mcreator.net/](https://mcreator.net/)
